frequency_question: What proportion of active-conflict recipient states successfully localize advanced Western cruise missile production within two years?
membership_rule: Includes any state receiving high-end Western missile technology that attempts domestic manufacturing or assembly during an ongoing war; excludes peacetime domestic production or simple licensed production without active conflict constraints.

cases.name: Taiwan's Hsiung Feng II/III domestic production
Pakistan's Babur cruise missile development under sanctions/conflict
Ukraine's Neptune missile serial production initiation

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 3 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 3 named; represents the specific class of high-tech missile localization under duress.
known_gaps: Excludes failed secret programs that remained classified.
skeleton: 3 successful localization efforts out of historical attempts involving technologically capable states under asymmetric pressure.
validity_reason: Industrial base dynamics and technology transfer constraints change slowly over multi-year periods.
